                                                      DOCKET NO. 59611


 APPLICATION OF EL PASO                                                 §   PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION
 ELECTRIC COMPANY FOR                                                   §
 APPROVAL OF A HIGH LOAD                                                §           OF TEXAS
 FACTOR LARGE POWER SERVICE                                             §
 TARIFF                                                                 §


                            ORDER NO. 3
   REQUIRING COMMENTS AND RECOMMENDATIONS ON THE APPLICATION,
  PROPOSED NOTICE, AND APPROPRIATE PROCESSING OF THE APPLICATION

          In Order No. 1 filed on April 8, 2026, the Administrative Law Judge (ALJ) established a
deadline of April 22, 2026 for Commission Staff to file comments and recommendations on the
administrative completeness of El Paso Electric Company’s April 7, 2026 application for approval
of a new tariff applicable to very large, high load factor customers. Commission Staff did not file
a recommendation or otherwise respond to Order No. 1.

          In Order No. 2 filed on April 24, 2026, the ALJ established a new deadline of April 29,
2026 for Commission Staff to file comments and recommendations on the administrative
completeness of El Paso Electric’s application. To date, Commission Staff has not filed its
recommendation or otherwise responded to Order No. 2.

          By May 15, 2026, Commission Staff must file its comments and recommendations on the
administrative completeness of the application and notice, and a proposal, including procedural
schedule, for the appropriate processing of this docket.

          Signed at Austin, Texas on the 1st day of May 2026.
                                                                 PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION OF TEXAS




                                                                 ERIC YOON
                                                                 ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGE
